{{Top|leg}}
A '''''Gaawan''''' was the title afforded to the leader of a [[Tuhgri]] tribe. The ''Gawaans'' of all the Tuhgri tribe formed the planetary government, meeting once a year at the [[House of Balance]] to settle disputes and enact planetary policy.
